name: craftkit
description: Quality gates for shipping work: prose that does not read as machine-written, pages that survive a phone, and a working agreement that makes agents verify before they claim.

plugins.name: craft-setup
plugins.description: The working agreement: verify before done, never commit unasked, enforce in code not prose, and keep checkers quiet enough to trust.

plugins.name: plainspoken
plugins.description: Fail the build when prose reads as machine-written. AI phrases, vague tails, paired adjectives, tool-list endings and abstraction, with presets for docs and resumes.

plugins.name: pagecheck
plugins.description: Layout and typography audit for built pages: overflow, ragged lines, tiny text, small tap targets, WCAG AA contrast.
